chunk: displayName: "ComputerEase by Deltek — job costing and accounting system for specialty/residential contractors"

knownQuirks: [
  "**CE Live Service relay required for API access:** ComputerEase APIs are NOT directly internet-accessible. Deltek/ComputerEase exposes APIs via a 'CE Live Service' Windows service installed on the same VM as ComputerEase itself. External callers must hit a Deltek-managed URL, which routes the call back to the client's CE Live Service, which then proxies to the local ComputerEase instance. This is described by Deltek architects as a legacy relay pattern — 'a little bit different setup than how the modern APIs work'. Plan extra time for Deltek support tickets to configure this on the client VM. (Source: peerless transcript, 2026-04-17 — Raghuram Potluri.)",
  "**Sandbox/practice environment has NO API access:** ComputerEase API Management menu is only available in the production environment. The practice (sandbox) environment does NOT expose API configuration. Attempts to access return 'Can't access API from practice'. Confirmed by Jean Jacobs (Peerless super-admin) on 2026-04-17. Implication: all API integration testing must occur in production with carefully scoped GET-only access groups until a separate Deltek-supported test path is negotiated. (Source: peerless transcript, 2026-04-17.)",
  "**User creation requires PWMAINT system account:** New ComputerEase users cannot be created from a normal admin's session, even a super-admin. To create users you must log in as the PWMAINT account (password 'mp' historically) from the login screen, NOT from inside any
